source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1961, p. 7 ("Dungannon")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the Tyrone unopposed-returns report read in the Belfast News-Letter of 17 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Dungannon Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Thirteen Unionists and six Nationalists were returned unopposed. The report names only the two Unionist changes, in Anahoe and Altmore; the other members are not listed. Returned unopposed in place of Mr. Thomas Loughran, who declined nomination. Returned unopposed.
